steps.step: MC0 source data: exact v117 monodromies M_a unitary with M_a^3 = I, closing on 12 elements (A4); w has orthonormal columns and sum_a w_a = 0 (surface relation in H_1)
A1 UR.RESIDUAL_RANK (channel A): kernel ranks from the family Fock vacuum stabilise; realization reproduces unused length-4/5 words
A2 SOURCE.MARK_ACTION (channel A): the four G_a are Hermitian for the kernel inner product (K-adjoint = itself)

A3 SOURCE.MARK_CLIFFORD (channel A): {G_a,G_b} = 2 g_ab I exactly with g = I - J/4 = projector onto H_1 (eigenvalues 0,1,1,1); sum_a G_a = 0; e_i = sum_a (w_a)_i G_a generate Cl(3); defect against AX.MARKCLIFFORD: g - I = -v v^T (beta direction)
steps.detail: scalar defect 4.4e-16; g diag 0.750, off -0.250; |sum G| 1.1e-16

steps.step: A4 channel A carriers: every gamma_a anticommutes with (-1)^F (fermion-odd, R1) and changes the family number (family-carrying, Part G kill); the partner Majoranas gamma'_a carry the same H_1 Gram and anticommute with gamma_b

A5 beta exists in the family CAR algebra as the three-body operator i gamma'_1 gamma'_2 gamma'_3: G~_a = gamma_a + beta/2 gives {G~_a, G~_b} = 2 delta_ab on the vacuum quotient (Cl(4)), but beta is fermion-odd, family-carrying, SO(3)-invariant and odd under improper relabelings (not S4-covariant) -> channel A dies by R1 + family-carrying, not by a missing beta

A5b distinction: Omega = i g1 g2 g3 (same Majoranas as the G_a) COMMUTES with every g_i -- the central pseudoscalar of Cl(3), no fourth generator; beta = i g'1 g'2 g'3 from the PARTNER Majoranas g'_i = -i(a_i - a_i^dag) ANTICOMMUTES with every g_i and squares to 1 -- only the partner product supplies the fourth Clifford direction (A5)

B1 UR.RESIDUAL_RANK (channel B, address): the kernel is block-diagonal in the address; its rank grows without bound (log-slope ~3): the bcc address is genuine future information and survives every quotient
B2 fiber at generic momentum: kernel rank 9 (faithful on M_3) for the tracial flavor state, 3 for a pure flavor state
B3 SOURCE.MARK_CLIFFORD (channel B): G_a^2, {G_a,G_b} and the K-Hermitian parts have no scalar anticommutators; relative operators Omega_ab have spectrum (1,-1,-1) x 3, never -I
steps.detail: min defects: square 1.00, anticommutator 1.00, Hermitian parts 0.25; min |Omega + I| 1.00

steps.step: B4 no quotient repairs channel B: the commutator subgroup is V4 acting as diag(1,-1,-1) in the 3-dim irrep (trivially in the 1-dim irreps); the generated algebra is M_3(C) (dimension 9), quotient elements are X (x) 1_m, and XY = -YX in M_3 forces det X det Y = 0 -> no Clifford pair of involutions; with the address the same holds pointwise in C(K, M_3)
B5 sheet-line or any central phase per visit leaves every relative operator unchanged
C1 graded locality (exact signs): operators at different marks commute up to (-1)^(|S||T|); parity-even ones always commute
C2 mark operators Gamma_a (product of the N zero modes at mark a): Hermitian involutions with Gamma_a Gamma_b = (-1)^N Gamma_b Gamma_a and fermion parity (-1)^N
steps.detail: N=1: commutation sign -1, parity -1, N=2: commutation sign +1, parity +1, N=3: commutation sign -1, parity -1, N=16: commutation sign +1, parity +1, N=17: commutation sign -1, parity -1

steps.step: C3 kernel quotients of the twist channel: nondegenerate Clifford exactly for odd N (both states); N = 16 and N = 2 give commuting mark operations with a nonzero defect
steps.detail: N=1 pairing: rank 4, defect 0.0, Clifford True; N=1 tracial: rank 16, defect 0.0, Clifford True; N=2 pairing: rank 4, defect 2.0, Clifford False; N=2 tracial: rank 16, defect 2.0, Clifford False; N=16 pairing: rank 4, defect 2.0, Clifford False; N=16 tracial: rank 16, defect 2.0, Clifford False; N=17 pairing: rank 4, defect 0.0, Clifford True; N=17 tracial: rank 16, defect 0.0, Clifford True

steps.step: C4 premise: N = 16 real sheet-odd species with species-singlet mark operators (Part U6/K9): class bit N mod 2 = 0 -> the twist channel yields commuting, parity-even mark operations
steps.detail: a single-species zero mode gamma_{s,a} anticommutes for any N but is fermion-odd and species-carrying

steps.step: S1 S4-invariant alternating forms on the mark-flip group F_2^4: exactly {0, J - I}; J - I nondegenerate over F_2 (extraspecial 2^(1+4): irreducible faithful dimension 4 = Cl(4))
S2 J - I does not descend to H_1(Sigma; F_2) = F_2^4/<1111> (B(1111, e_a) = 1): with the closed-seam relation imposed on the flips, only the trivial (commuting) class exists

S3 S4-invariant symmetric Grams on R^4 are a I + b J; the linear surface relation (null vector 1111) forces b = -a/4, i.e. g proportional to I - J/4 (channel A, Cl(3)); without it any positive a I + b J orthonormalises to Cl(4)

MC9 (statement) SOURCE.MARK_CLIFFORD.01 = NO_GO_FROM_CURRENT_SOURCE: the quotient keeps every source relation (FE5); the Clifford structures the channels contain (A3/A5, single-species zero modes) are fermion-odd and family/species-carrying, channel B has no Clifford pair, parity-even species-singlet twist operations commute (C); minimal missing input = ONE Z2 projective class bit on an internal-singlet coin: on independent mark flips (AX.MARKSIGN -> Cl(4), g = I) or, for chiral Theta_1, the spin-1/2 (2T) class of A4 on C^2 (AX.WEYLCOIN); the H_1 Gram of such a coin is symmetry-forced (Schur)
